scope: CPU read-only review and mocked compiler contract tests; no candidate compilation or GPU execution by reviewer
resolved_findings: Digraph/trigraph directive spellings rejected; form-feed, vertical-tab and CR preprocessing whitespace normalized.
Lexical comment stripping respects quoted literals and escapes; the unused-macro quoted-comment local-include regression is rejected.
Successful exit requires a nonempty AIR artifact, not merely exit zero.
Both snapshotted inputs are rechecked after the second compile, preventing earlier-source mutation from silently passing.
limitations: The supported-format filter is not a security sandbox or a complete C++ preprocessor. Review sources before compiling them.
AIR compilation does not establish linking, GPU execution, numerical parity, performance, or full upstream-commit correctness.
Only exact source-pair snapshots and fixed validation flags are tested, not necessarily original project flags or host dispatch.
Compiler version/SDK output and local checksums establish local receipt consistency, not externally authenticated provenance.
Importer execution_verified_examples remains zero; this compile-only gate does not promote source examples.
Parent actual TensorFold compile receipt was produced before the latest parser hardening; this review does not relabel that historical script identity.
